description: Animate a character look (or your own photo) into a short video clip. Same as `clipugc videos create`. Costs 7 credits for 5 seconds or 13 for 10 seconds; adding scene makes it a scene-staged clip (9 at 5s, 15 at 10s). Confirm with get_credits first. Prefer a silent reaction prompt (mouth closed, no talking, an arc in beats, ambient motion): lip-sync from a still image is what makes AI video look fake. Provide exactly one of image or photo. Returns the clip id and status. Generation runs in the background. Poll get_video with {"id": <clip id>, "kind": "clip"} every 5 to 10 seconds until status is "completed" or "failed", then call download_video.

image.description: Id of a generated character look (same as --image).

photo.description: Local path to your own photo, png/jpg/jpeg/webp; uploaded first (same as --photo).

prompt.description: What the character does, max 1500 chars (same as --prompt).

scene.description: Extra scene description, max 600 chars; makes it a scene-staged clip (same as --scene).

name: create_clip
title: Create a video clip from a look
